
  ╭─────────────────────────────────────────────╮
  │  /settings  (/set)                          │
  │  Agent Settings                             │
  ╰─────────────────────────────────────────────╯

  Summary:
    View or change agent configuration parameters.

  Usage:
    /settings
    /settings <key> <value>
    /settings security_level <level>
    /settings reasoning [level]

  Details:
    Manage RadSim's internal settings:
    
      • (no args)          — Interactive menu
      • <key>              — View a single setting
      • <key> <value>      — Change a setting
      • security_level     — Set preset (strict/balanced/permissive)
      • reasoning          — Pick a reasoning effort from the levels the
                             current model supports (menu with no args)

  Examples:
    $ /settings
    $ /settings security_level strict
    $ /settings reasoning
    $ /set self_improvement.enabled true

  Related: /evolve  /config
